title: Local characteristic polynomial identity on a product cover
statement: Given the two locally free covers and any product cover with the expected local bases, the locally free characteristic polynomial of the product endomorphism equals the product of the two characteristic polynomials.

proof.text: Apply the characterizing property after scalar extension to every product localization, use the free direct-sum characteristic-polynomial identity, and descend coefficientwise by localization injectivity.

lean.statement:
theorem locallyFreeCharpoly_prodIdentity
    {A : Type u} {M₁ : Type v₁} {M₂ : Type v₂} [CommRing A]
    [AddCommGroup M₁] [Module A M₁] [AddCommGroup M₂] [Module A M₂]
    {n₁ n₂ r₁ r₂ : ℕ} (f₁ : Fin r₁ → A) (f₂ : Fin r₂ → A)
    (hgen₁ : Ideal.span (Set.range f₁) = ⊤)
    (hgen₂ : Ideal.span (Set.range f₂) = ⊤)
    (hfree₁ : ∀ i : Fin r₁,
      ∃ _e : Module.Basis (Fin n₁) (Localization.Away (f₁ i))
        (LocalizedModule.Away (f₁ i) M₁), True)
    (hfree₂ : ∀ j : Fin r₂,
      ∃ _e : Module.Basis (Fin n₂) (Localization.Away (f₂ j))
        (LocalizedModule.Away (f₂ j) M₂), True)
    (φ₁ : M₁ →ₗ[A] M₁) (φ₂ : M₂ →ₗ[A] M₂)
    {g : Fin (r₁ * r₂) → A}
    (hggen : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤)
    (hgfree : ∀ k : Fin (r₁ * r₂),
      ∃ _e : Module.Basis (Fin (n₁ + n₂)) (Localization.Away (g k))
        (LocalizedModule.Away (g k) (M₁ × M₂)), True)
    (hg : g = fun k ↦ f₁ (finProdFinEquiv.symm k).1 * f₂ (finProdFinEquiv.symm k).2) :
    locallyFreeCharpoly g hggen hgfree (φ₁.prodMap φ₂) =
      locallyFreeCharpoly f₁ hgen₁ hfree₁ φ₁ * locallyFreeCharpoly f₂ hgen₂ hfree₂ φ₂
